title: Network+ vs Security+: Which Should You Take First?
excerpt: Network+ builds the networking base; Security+ is the step into cybersecurity.
description: Network+ vs Security+: what each CompTIA certification covers, who it's for, and which order works best for most people.
body:
Most people take Network+ before Security+. Network+ teaches how networks work, and Security+ builds on that knowledge to cover how to protect them.

## CompTIA Network+

- Covers networking concepts, network setup, operations, security and troubleshooting
- Great for network support and junior network admin roles
- Gives you the foundation many security topics rely on

## CompTIA Security+

- Covers general security concepts, threats, security architecture, operations and governance
- One of the most requested entry-level cybersecurity certifications
- A strong step towards security analyst roles

## Which order?

- New to IT: A+, then Network+, then Security+
- Already comfortable with networking: go straight to Security+
- Aiming for a security career: take both, Network+ first

## How to prepare

- Use the official exam objectives as your checklist
- Study one domain at a time and focus on your weakest areas
- Book the exam when you score 85% or more consistently in practice
